									<h2><strong>How does it work</strong></h2><p>From the moment a phone call is received, the Caller SDK activates instantly. Powered by our AI-driven platform, it creates a faster, smoother path for users to engage with your app, delivering useful features exactly when they’re most relevant.</p><p>The Caller SDK seamlessly integrates a detailed call information screen directly into your app. This screen is shown to users every time a call is received, made, or missed.</p><p>Once the call ends, your app can present this screen alongside contextual features linked to the call details. For example, a calendar app could let users create a new event straight from the call screen, automatically using the caller’s contact information.</p><p>By placing your app in front of users after every call, the Caller SDK significantly boosts engagement and enhances the overall experience through timely, high-value functionality.</p>								</div>
